newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW-Analysts say Sweden budget too loose.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Analysts say Sweden budget too loose.

text.p: Following are analysts' views on Sweden's supplementary budget proposal, which has been leaked to the press before its 1100 GMT publication.

JAMES MCKAY, PAINEWEBBER - "If this turns out to be true then the market is certainly going to be worried, it's going to be taken as a sign that the government would rather win grassroot support than keep an absolute check on fiscal policies."
There's going to be a lot of nervousness and I expect upward pressure on interest rates today," McKay said.

PETER LINDQVIST, HSBC MIDLAND - "This is not positive, it gives the impression the government is in the mood to spend money. (But) Foreign markets are strong so I believe rates will open unchanged or slightly weaker.
